bull.b: Rapid subscription growth and above-100% retention indicate customers are expanding usage of Waystar’s platform. This recurring revenue mix should improve revenue visibility and support durable growth as the installed base adopts additional solutions.

Strong margins and substantial operating and free cash flow show that Waystar’s software model is converting scale into earnings and liquidity. These resources can fund product development, debt reduction and customer expansion while supporting financial resilience.

Cross-selling Iodine capabilities into the existing customer base broadens Waystar’s product footprint and increases value per account. Combining clinical and financial data may help providers prevent denials, creating a durable rationale for adoption and expansion.

bear.b: The recent slowdown from earlier growth rates raises questions about the pace at which Waystar can expand beyond its installed base. Continued moderation in volume-based revenue could make subscription growth and cross-selling more important to sustaining overall momentum.

Although leverage improved, the debt balance remains significant relative to the company’s scale. Interest obligations and refinancing needs could constrain flexibility if growth weakens, cash conversion deteriorates or investment requirements rise faster than expected.

bear.t: Higher AI Investment and Cash Requirements
bear.b: Accelerated AI and software investment may strengthen the product over time, but it increases near-term capital requirements and execution risk. If compute costs or development spending remain elevated, cash generation and margin sustainability could face pressure.
